method: Human visual inspection by the authoring assistant of all page contact sheets, with full-size mathematical and crosswalk pages. Final section breaks, table continuations, equations, title, contents and references checked. After the final PDF anchor correction, all 29 newly rendered page images were byte-identical to the reviewed images.
findings: No clipping, overlapping text, missing mathematical glyphs, or nearly blank spillover pages found.
Kept example heading with its code block and residual theorem heading with its proposition.
Questions and appendices begin on deliberate pages; references fit together.
Intentional whitespace remains around unsplit tables and separate appendices.
limitation: Visual layout review only; not mathematical proof or accessibility certification.
